items.headline: Houthi hamla: Saudi refinery me Nepali mara
items.detail: Saudi Arabia ki Jazan refinery par Houthi hamle me ek Nepali mazdoor mara gaya aur kai ghayal hue; aag lagi aur kuchh hissa band hua.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, Yemen yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia khadan baadh: 13 mare, 13 laapata
items.detail: Indonesia ke Bogor me gair-kanuni sone ki khadan me baadh se 13 mazdoor mare gaye aur 13 abhi 100 meter gehri khadan me fanse hain.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia, khanan durghatna — UPSC

items.headline: Russia ne Kyiv par missile hamla kiya
items.detail: Russia ne raat me Kyiv par ballistic missile se hamla kiya; ek shopping centre aur 2 imaratein nishana bani, 7 log ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: FIFA par cyber hamla, data chori hua
items.detail: FIFA ne kaha woh ek cyber hamle ka shikar hui, jisme vyaktigat aur vyavsayik jankari churai gayi; hamlaawaron ne staff bankar ghuspaith ki.
items.exam_angle: FIFA, cyber hamla — UPSC

items.headline: Trump: Putin G20 me aa sakte hain
items.detail: Trump ne kaha, Putin chahein to 14-15 December ko Miami me hone wale G20 sammelan me aa sakte hain; nimantran pehle se hai, Kremlin ne abhi faisla nahi liya.
items.exam_angle: G20, America-Russia, Putin — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kuwait me drone hamle me 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait ke ek hawai raksha kendra par drone hamle me Rheinmetall Italia ke 2 technician mare gaye; Italy aur Kuwait ne Iran par aarop lagaya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Kuwait, Iran, drone hamla — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cuba ke paas jahaz dooba, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Panama jhande wala cargo jahaz Halima Cuba ke Artemisa tat ke paas doob gaya; 16 me se 13 mile, jinme ek ki maut hui, 3 abhi laapata hain.

items.headline: China ne Taiwan ke saamne landing abhyaas kiya
items.detail: China ne Fujian ke Dacheng Bay me nagrik jahazon ko jodkar lagbhag 800 meter lamba tairta pul banakar Taiwan par utarne ka abhyaas kiya; Taiwan ke raksha mantralaya ne kaha woh is gatividhi par nazar rakhe hue hai.
items.exam_angle: China-Taiwan, amphibious abhyaas — UPSC IR

items.headline: Drone Latvia ki hawai seema me ghusa
items.detail: Shukravaar subah ek ajnaat drone thodi der ke liye Latvia ki hawai seema me ghusa; NATO ke ladaku viman aur interceptor drone bheje gaye, koi nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Latvia, NATO, drone ghuspaith — UPSC IR

items.headline: Duterte ka ICC mukadma Somvaar se
items.detail: Philippines ke poorv rashtrapati Rodrigo Duterte par ICC me manavta ke khilaf apraadh ka mukadma 30 November se shuru hoga; unpar 2011-2019 ke beech 85 hatyaon ke aarop hain.
items.exam_angle: ICC, Philippines, manavta ke khilaf apraadh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Erdogan ne Mecca raksha samjhota manzoor kiya
items.detail: Turkey ke rashtrapati Erdogan ne Pakistan aur Saudi Arabia ke saath Mecca sanyukt raksha samjhote ko aupcharik manzoori di; sansad ne ise 5 November ko pass kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: Turkey, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia raksha samjhota — UPSC IR

items.headline: Britain me net migration 29 saal me kam
items.detail: Britain ki net migration June 2026 tak ke saal me girkar 77,000 reh gayi, 1997 ke baad sabse kam; Bharatiya aane aur jaane dono me sabse bada samuh rahe.
items.exam_angle: Britain, migration, Bharatiya pravasi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Costa Rica ne UN rapporteur ko roka
items.detail: Costa Rica ne UN rapporteur Francesca Albanese ko desh me pravesh se roka; sarkar ne aatankwadi gatividhiyon se sambandh wali antarrashtriya alert ka hawala diya, jabki ve maanad degree lene aayi thi.
items.exam_angle: UN, Costa Rica, manavadhikar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Altria, Japan Tobacco Imperial kharidne ki taiyari me
items.detail: America ki Altria ne Britain ki Imperial Brands ke liye nagad khareed prastav par vichaar ki pushti ki; Japan Tobacco bhi sajhedari me hissa lene par vichaar kar raha hai, sauda lagbhag 34 arab dollar ka ho sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: Videshi nivesh, vilay — arthvyavastha

items.headline: Australia ne Iran se jude 2 par pratibandh
items.detail: Australia ne Sydney aur Melbourne me 2024 ke yahudi-virodhi aagjani hamlo ke liye Iran ke IRGC ki or se kaam karne ke aarop me do vyaktiyon par aatankwadi vittaposhan pratibandh lagaye.
items.exam_angle: Australia, Iran, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Britain ne 1 lakh reservist ko taiyar kiya
items.detail: Britain ke raksha mantralaya ne Sheet Yuddh ke baad pehli baar lagbhag 1 lakh poorv sainikon ko patra likhkar yuddh ki sthiti me wapas bulaye jaane ki taiyari karne ko kaha; ye kadam Russia ke badhte khatre ke beech uthaya gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Britain, NATO, Russia khatra — UPSC IR

items.headline: Eisenkot ko sarkar ke liye dusra samjhota
items.detail: Israel me Gadi Eisenkot ki Yashar party ne vaam-panthi Democrats se gathbandhan samjhota kiya; do samjhauton ke baad bhi unke gut ke paas 120 me se sirf 36 seat hain, bahumat ke liye 61 chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Israel sarkar gathan, Knesset — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump: Huang koi suraksha khatra nahi
items.detail: America ke rashtrapati Trump ne kaha Nvidia ke CEO Jensen Huang koi suraksha khatra nahi hain; unhone khud Nvidia board se Huang ko CEO pad par wapas lane ko kaha tha.
items.exam_angle: America, AI chip, Nvidia — arthvyavastha

items.headline: Ukraine ke laser ne Russian drone giraya
items.detail: Ukraine ka daava hai ki uske Blysk laser hathiyar ne pehli baar ladai me Russia ka jet-powered Geran drone giraya; ye pranali ek mahatvapurna sthal ki raksha kar rahi thi.
items.exam_angle: Laser raksha pranali aur drone yuddh

items.headline: Abrego Garcia America se Spain pahunche
items.detail: Galat tareeke se El Salvador bhej diye gaye Kilmar Abrego Garcia ne America se khud Spain jaane ka faisla kiya aur budhvaar subah Madrid pahunche; unhone kaha is baar ve aazadi ke saath ja rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki immigration neeti aur nirvasan vivad

items.headline: Prince William ke ghar me chori, 2 giraftar
items.detail: Sandringham estate par Prince William aur Princess Catherine ke Anmer Hall me ghuskar ghadi aur cufflinks churane ke aarop me do logo par case darj hua; us samay ghar me koi shahi sadasya maujood nahi tha.

items.headline: Ukraine ko 45 arab euro karz ka samarthan
items.detail: EU shikhar sammelan me 24 sadasya deshon ne 2027 ke liye Ukraine ko 45 arab euro tak ke karz ke prastav ka samarthan kiya; antim faisla December me hoga.
items.exam_angle: EU aur Ukraine vittiya sahayata

items.headline: New Zealand me sarkar ka bahumat khatm
items.detail: Antim chunav parinamo me PM Christopher Luxon ki gathbandhan sarkar 130 seaton wali sansad me 65 seat par atak gayi, ab Opportunity Party ke samarthan ke bina sarkar nahi banegi.
items.exam_angle: New Zealand chunav parinam aur gathbandhan sarkar

items.headline: Gaza me hamle, Hamas neta samet 10 mare
items.detail: Guruvaar ko Israel ke hamlo me Gaza me kam se kam 10 log mare, jinme Hamas ke varishth neta Khaled Abu Nada bhi shaamil the; Hamas ne jawab dene ki chetavni di hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine sangharsh aur Gaza yuddh-viram
